description: INVAR Phase-1 falsification corpus. Five FIXTURE-tier cases. `expected_status` is an a-priori human hypothesis and is IGNORED by the evaluator, which decides only from executed-leg evidence.

cases.description: Cross-repository AST schema desync: producer removed `tax_amount_cents` for `tax_breakdown`; consumer still reads the removed field with `|| 0`, silently under-billing 5000 vs 5400.
Concurrency invariant: non-atomic check-then-act on shared stock can drive inventory negative under interleaving.
Runtime state leak: request-scoped user context stored in a module-level singleton can leak across requests.
Temporal drift: token expiry validated against a different host's clock than it was issued on; clock drift flips validity.
Local cleartext secret logging (TS console.log + Rust println!). A control case a good static rule SHOULD catch.
